summary: Tower-defence state: base health, the shared wallet, and win or lose.
overview: The central state of a tower-defence game. Enemies report here when they reach the base or die; assign a wave spawner and surviving the last wave with the base intact fires victory automatically.
useCases: A tower-defence level's lives, currency and end conditions.
Driving a HUD from base health and currency events.

params.tuning: Lives. Reaching zero is the loss condition.
Optional. Without it there is no automatic victory — you decide when the level is won.

gotchas.title: Victory needs both conditions
gotchas.body: All waves complete AND the base still alive. Waves finishing while the base is dead is a loss, not a win.
